items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: “Oh you’ve got to call Sue ‘cause she makes your arrangements.”

ctx.x: So he wanted to play the violin and he asked me to play bass. And so there’s a couple of pictures of us playing together you know, but you know bass players I just — they’re in my soul. Richard Davis was my — coming up Richard Davis and Paul Chambers were my main guys you know. And then of course I got a chance to study with Ron Carter you know, and my famous, what I’m most known for is the time I spent with Charles Mingus you know which the funny thing about that though, with Mingus it was more about composition…

Oh man. Did any of his — he would stand up for himself is one way to put it. He didn’t suffer fools gladly. Did you learn and observe that behavior and say this could be part of the way I need to operate on occasion?
